bibl.title: BSB: Berean Standard Bible
bibl.note: Complete acquired scrollmapper/bible_databases BSB JSON electronic witness: all 66 ordered books, 1,189 chapters and 31,102 source verse records, including 16 exact empty strings, in one existing work and one TEI. Literal strings, Unicode, leading/trailing whitespace, numbers, original IDs, ordering and attachments are conserved. Reversible generated scaffolds change only 66 book n ordinals to their literal source names, mark all 31,102 strings with xml:space=preserve, remove generated text@type=bible, and renew the qualified header. Independent inversion restores exact historical native d2382c bytes. Separate spreadsheet/repository CC0 and credit metadata is permission/comparison support, not the acquired JSON textual source or a confirmed print equivalence. Human acceptance, underlying rights assessment and public publication remain separate.

The acquired JSON has no named translators, editors, publisher, imprint or copyright fields. Separate retained openbible-io BSB metadata names BSB Publishing and lists advisors and extended translation notes; these are not silently allocated to the exact JSON witness. Config 2020 and April 2023 claims remain historical metadata support, not a freshly confirmed print or dedication date.

Separate retained openbible-io/bsb metadata associates Berean Standard Bible with CC0-1.0; its full CC0 1.0 Universal legal text is retained and visibly reproduced. The scrollmapper repository MIT software permission is retained separately. These observations do not assert verified byte equivalence to its spreadsheet, legal clearance for the exact JSON witness, or publication authorization.

Original generated text role bible is declared here rather than retained as an unsupported text attribute. All source string carriers receive explicit xml:space=preserve, including 16 true-empty strings; no filling, trimming or verse omission.
